echo_intro.text: Blue Arrow has never seen the sky. All she remembers is Cell 7, deep inside a facility run by the Directorate, an arm of a civilization far older than ours, and the experiments. They left her one gift: she can see with sound. Tonight the power failed. The doors are dead, the halls are dark, and this is her chance.

echo_free.text: The hatch gives way to cold air and more sky than she has words for. Behind her the alarms fade into the hum of the facility. She doesn't look back. Her name is Blue Arrow, and she is free.

echo_caught_1.text: Lights. Hands on her shoulders. A voice says "Back to Cell 7." Not tonight. Try again.

echo_caught_2.text: The drone's light pins her to the wall. She hears the guards coming. Try again.

echo_caught_3.text: The alarm screams through the floor. She is not going back. Try again.

echo_memory_1.text: Subject 7. That is what the clipboard said. Someone called me something else, once.

echo_memory_2.text: The tests were always the same: a dark room, a tone, a wall I had to find without touching it.

echo_memory_3.text: They never told me what I was for. Only that I was improving.

echo_memory_4.text: A screen was left on in the lab once. Blue, with white shapes drifting across it. I think it was the sky.

echo_memory_5.text: The reactor floors hum all night. I learned the shape of every hall from that hum.

echo_memory_6.text: They gave me a number so I would forget my name. I never did. My name is Blue Arrow.

puff_intro.text: Puff flies beside the jet in a water bubble, but he is not from Earth. His home was an ocean world, coral and light, until the corporations bled it dark. Then the Directorate chose it for one of their games: survive the trials, and win the power to heal your world. These are the trials, the way Puff remembers them.

memory1_intro_1.text: Past the horizon the stars go quiet, and Puff is home again.

memory1_intro_2.text: His ocean world was coral and light once, until the corporations bled it dark. Then the Directorate came, and they called it a game: survive our trials, and we will give you the power to heal your world.

memory1_intro_3.text: He was the only one who could breathe that water long enough. Nobody asked him if he wanted to play.

memory1_voice_1.text: Subject accepted. The first trial begins.

memory1_puff_1.text: I never said yes. Nobody asked.

memory1_voice_2.text: Your world is watching, little fish.

memory1_voice_3.text: Survive our trials and your sea will be healed. That is our promise.

memory1_puff_2.text: Keep swimming. For the reef. For everyone.

memory1_end_1.text: Subject survives. Proceed to trial two.

memory1_end_2.text: There were more trials. There was always one more.

cs_intro_01.text: In a vast universe, one civilization rose so far above the rest that nothing could ever challenge it.

cs_intro_02.text: With unlimited power and nothing left to want, its people grew bored.

cs_intro_03.text: So they made a game out of everyone else.

cs_intro_04.text: They staged trials. Rigged wars. Promised salvation to worlds that played along — and harvested the ones that failed.

cs_intro_05.text: We call them the Overseers. To them, a dying planet is entertainment.

cs_intro_06.text: Her world was one of their pieces. Its people lived under the boots of the Overseers' enforcers.

cs_intro_07.text: She kept her head down, like everyone else. Her best friend stayed close beside her.

cs_intro_08.text: Until the day two guards cornered an old woman in the street.

cs_intro_10.text: Nobody had ever said that out loud before.

cs_intro_12.text: They burned her home to the ground. They dragged her best friend away.

cs_intro_14.text: No windows. No names. Test after test, in the dark, for years.

cs_intro_15.text: She stopped counting the days. She never stopped listening.

cs_intro_16.text: The lights died. The doors slid open.

cs_intro_17.text: She couldn't see a thing. But every sound came back to her — a wall, a ledge, a way out.

cs_echo_complete_01.text: Like a lost fish finding its school, she followed the echoes all the way to the surface.

cs_echo_complete_02.text: For the first time in years: open air.

cs_echo_complete_03.text: She stole a ship and ran — past her burning home, out into the stars.

cs_echo_complete_04.text: She took refuge on a distant world, far from the Overseers' reach.

cs_echo_complete_05.text: Someone had been listening for her, too.

cs_echo_complete_06.text: We protect the worlds the Overseers play with. You already know what they do.

cs_echo_complete_08.text: In hiding, she trained. Every day. Every target.

cs_echo_complete_09.text: The escaped experiment became a pilot. Call sign: Blue Arrow.

cs_puff_intro_01.text: Blue Arrow, meet your new wingmate.

cs_puff_intro_03.text: A pufferfish from an ocean world. He flies like he has nothing left to lose. He never talks about home.

cs_puff_complete_01.text: I passed every trial. I did everything they asked.

cs_puff_complete_04.text: Puff survived. His home, and everyone he fought for, did not.

cs_puff_complete_05.text: They were never going to keep that promise. They never do.

cs_puff_complete_06.text: Thanks for not pushing. Back when we met.

cs_puff_complete_07.text: Then we make sure it never happens to anyone else.

cs_vanguard_intro_03.text: To rescue her best friend. To set her planet free.

cs_vanguard_intro_05.text: They took everything from me once. Not again.

cs_vanguard_complete_01.text: The enforcers retreat. For the first time in years, her world sees an open sky.

cs_vanguard_complete_02.text: But the Overseers are still watching.

cs_vanguard_complete_03.text: And now, so is Earth Vanguard.

radio_anvil_starlance_weapons_free_clear.text: Starlance, Blue Arrow: weapons free. Clear the range.

radio_anvil_big_contact_inbound_hit.text: Big contact inbound. Hit the core between its volleys.

radio_anvil_target_down_good_flying.text: Target down. Good flying, Blue Arrow. Bring it home.

radio_anvil_vip_aboard_that_changes.text: VIP aboard! That changes things, Blue Arrow.

radio_anvil_puff_s_tether_is.text: Puff's tether is gone! Hold your course, Blue Arrow. You can't follow him in.

radio_anvil_got_him_reel_him.text: Got him! Reel him in, Blue Arrow.

radio_puff_bubble_sealed_tether_locked.text: Bubble sealed, tether locked. Try not to fly into anything this time, Blue Arrow.

radio_puff_that_thing_is_singing.text: That thing is singing. I know that song.

radio_puff_no_no_not_again.text: No. No, not again! Blue Arrow!

radio_puff_thanks_i_owe_you.text: ...Thanks, Blue Arrow. I owe you one.

radio_sparrow_gravity_well_ahead_keep.text: Gravity well ahead! Keep your thrust up and stay off the rim.

radio_sparrow_pod_secured_they_say.text: Pod secured. They say thanks, Blue Arrow!

radio_sparrow_covering_the_pod_bring.text: Covering the pod. Bring it in!

prompt_test_choice.text: A distress beacon is pinging off the flight path. Divert to cover the pod?

prompt_puff_trust1.text: Puff is curled up tight in his bubble, spines out, staring back at the black hole.

radio_anvil_kerr_station_is_breaking.text: Kerr Station is breaking up. Clear a path for the lifeboats.

radio_puff_another_black_hole_keep.text: Another black hole. Keep the tether short, Blue Arrow.

radio_sparrow_spears_lock_on_then.text: Spears lock on, then ram. When the nose glows red, sidestep!

radio_sparrow_snipers_see_the_red.text: Snipers. See the red line? That's where the shot goes. Don't be there.

radio_sparrow_weaver_spiral_guns_circle.text: Weaver! Spiral guns. Circle with the spiral, not against it.

radio_anvil_that_s_kerr_s.text: That's Kerr's Eye ahead. A black hole on a leash. Stay sharp.

radio_puff_it_isn_t_singing.text: It isn't singing. Good. Keep it that way.

radio_anvil_lance_cell_a_beam.text: Lance cell! A beam that cuts through everything in a line. Try it.

radio_anvil_gravity_well_it_pulls.text: Gravity well! It pulls you in. Don't use focus near it, you'll lose speed.

radio_sparrow_ha_it_ate_their.text: Ha! It ate their drones. Your shots bend around it too. Use that.

radio_anvil_tug_ship_towing_a.text: Tug ship towing a black hole. Kill it and the hole drifts loose.

radio_puff_they_tow_them_around.text: They tow them around like cargo. Like it's nothing.

radio_anvil_vip_pod_falling_toward.text: VIP pod falling toward that hole. Grab it before the horizon does!

radio_sparrow_got_her_dr_osei.text: Got her! Dr. Osei, Lagrange Deep. She says you're crazy, Blue Arrow. In a good way.

radio_sparrow_lifeboats_are_clear_of.text: Lifeboats are clear of the station. Nice flying, Blue Arrow!

radio_anvil_big_signature_on_the.text: Big signature on the end of the leash. The siege engine. Cut it loose.

radio_anvil_its_pull_is_climbing.text: Its pull is climbing! Stay fast. It can't hold a ship at full speed.

radio_sparrow_containment_s_failing_and.text: Containment's failing and the hole is growing. Finish it fast!

radio_anvil_the_leash_is_cut.text: The leash is cut and the Eye is fading. Outstanding work, Blue Arrow.

radio_puff_still_here_thanks_for.text: ...Still here. Thanks for keeping the tether short.
